title: San Diego Jeep Tours
includes: Exclusive use of 4x4 Jeep with seating for 5
Guide-led trip lasting 2-4 hours with stops at various way-points
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We offer a four-wheeling experience like no other in San Diego and are popular with experienced off-roaders and first-timers alike!

Whether you’ve never driven off-road or are a seasoned pro, you’ll quickly build confidence, refine your techniques, have fun along the way and create lifelong memories.
We will navigate high, steep climbs and heart-pounding descents, while taking in some of the most beautiful country around, all with the feeling of confidence and safety.

An Experience Like No Other. Enjoy the great outdoors while developing off-road skills to tackle the most extreme terrain. Drive one of our 4×4 vehicles and enjoy one-to-one guidance
